# Shrivatsa Pendant Guide

> Product information and traditional jewellery guidance focused on Indriya's Shrivatsa Gold Lakshmi Pendant.

Product specifications are presented separately from styling and cultural guidance. Consult the linked official Indriya sources for current product information, prices, availability and customer support. This site does not publish verified offers or customer ratings.

## Pages

- [Shrivatsa Gold Lakshmi Pendant](/lakshmi-pendant): 22K yellow gold pendant specifications, styling and frequently asked questions.
- [Temple Jewellery Guide](/temple-jewellery-guide): Meaning, traditional motifs and jewellery care guidance.
- [Traditional Jewellery](/traditional-jewellery): Traditional jewellery context and the featured Lakshmi pendant.
- [Bridal Jewellery](/bridal-jewellery): Bridal jewellery context and the featured Lakshmi pendant.
- [About](/about): Brand context and the site's sourcing approach.
- [Contact](/contact): Official Indriya customer support and store information.
- [Store Locator](/store-locator): Access to official Indriya store information.

## Optional

- [Official Indriya website](https://www.indriya.com/): The external brand website for current information.
